meta.source: Derived from Dinoy Raj's conference decks (DevFest Dubai, DevFest Mumbai, FOSSASIA, droidcon Uganda)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default slide background. Most content slides are plain white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, titles and bullet copy on `surface`, `green-tint`, `blue-tint` and `lime` (21:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Column labels and diagram captions on `surface` (9.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Card titles, card descriptions, footnotes and the event line on `surface` (7:1) and `gray-row`.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The signature colour. Full-bleed section, demo and closing slides; bullet dots; numbered step discs; green topic tags; highlight words for the payoff or outcome. As text on white it is 3:1, so only at 24px and up.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on `green` slides: statements, the giant Demo numeral, Thankyou. 3:1 on green, so 24px and up only (every observed use is 48px+).

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Soft green panels and tiles (Clean Architecture background, open-model logo tiles, emphasis tile in a trio), and the small status chip on green slides.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Faintest green fill for diagram nodes and inactive tiles on white.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The accent. Topic tag pills, the caption pill on green slides, the vertical accent bar on question slides, the period after Thankyou/Demo. Text on lime is always `on-lime` or `ink`.

tokens.name: lime-deep
tokens.usage: Speaker pill on the title slide (bleeds off the left edge).

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text inside lime topic tags (10.6:1 on `lime`).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Highlight words naming the subject or concept, the event pill on title slides, gradient numerals 01/02, table header rows, the active diagram node. As text on white it is 3.6:1, so highlight words stay 24px and up.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Soft blue panels: option cards, prompt/response stages, comparison panels, the second tile in a mint/blue pair.

tokens.name: blue-panel
tokens.usage: Background behind illustrations and device mockups (droidcon Uganda).

tokens.name: blue-row
tokens.usage: Alternating row in data tables (with `gray-row`).

tokens.name: gray-row
tokens.usage: Alternating row in data tables; light code-snippet cards on white.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px lines of the background grid on question and statement slides; dividers.

tokens.name: card-border
tokens.usage: 2px outline of white feature cards.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Diagram-only: the middle phase in multi-stage flows (Composition, Layout, Drawing). Never for text or highlights.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Diagram-only: the final phase node in multi-stage flows; white text on it (13:1).

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background and dark screenshot frames.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Plain identifiers in code on `code-bg` (14:1).

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (val, data, class, fun, import) on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-type
tokens.usage: Types, packages, annotations and parameter names on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-punct
tokens.usage: Brackets, dots, colons and commas on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments (italic) and line numbers on `code-bg`. 2.6:1 by design: recessive, never carry meaning in a comment.

families.sans: "Google Sans", "Google Sans Flex", "Product Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Source Code Pro", "Google Sans Code", ui-monospace, monospace

styles.name: demo-numeral
styles.usage: Giant white word on green demo slides; bleeds off the bottom edge.

styles.name: closing
styles.usage: Closing and Demo-QR slides, white on green, period in lime.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Talk title on the title slide, 3 lines max, highlight words in blue and green.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Question / statement slides over the grid; highlights at 500.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Slide headline, top-left, when a deck uses headlines instead of topic tags.

styles.name: green-statement
styles.usage: Centred white line above a lime pill on green section slides.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Bullet copy. Highlights at 500 in blue/green.

styles.name: pill-caption
styles.sample: Running Gemma Models Directly On Android App
styles.usage: Text in the large lime pill on green slides and in green statement pills.

styles.name: speaker
styles.usage: Speaker name in the title slide pill.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Topic tag pill text, Title Case.

styles.name: speaker-role
styles.usage: Role line under the speaker name, in `green`.

styles.name: code-l
styles.usage: Hero code block, up to ~10 lines.

styles.name: code-s
styles.usage: Dense code beside bullets, up to ~25 lines.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag and its secondary segment; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row; caption gap under a card.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Gap between bullets in a group; card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Inset of topic tags from the top and left edges.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Left content margin for headlines, titles and bullets.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Pitch of the background grid on statement slides (lines every 528px, 274px row offset).

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Diagram boxes.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Inner corners of table rows (the segmented list).

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks and screenshot frames.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: White outlined feature cards, every tinted tile (mint, blue, solid, outline), callout boxes, the agenda fact tile and the table's outer corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every tag, caption pill, chip and the speaker pill.
